question: In a certain code language, 'RESULT' is written as 'LUTERS' and 'BARLEY' is written as 'ELYABR'. How will 'HEAVEN' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'RESULT' is written as 'LUTERS',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50fecd1654c134116f228cb9edadc9386eb1403a9484030fd91335518cac0301.png] 

‘BARLEY' is written as 'ELYABR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c22eab7b4cc390e6dad4a2db54bdc63cbd821ffd88904f8a9cd388a083242323.png] 

Similarly, for 'HEAVEN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cd322d23aa80f6f96248df92fa5a1b51794af3d952ad52682974d182ec5b045.png] 

So, 'HEAVEN' will be written as 'EVNEHA'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
